result.title: Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon
result.summary: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文用探针从冻结的 ViT patch embedding 中解码「同物体」信号，发现该绑定信号并非全局性质，而是随 patch 间距离以指数形式衰减、并收敛到非零下限，即存在有限的空间作用范围；作者在多个数据集、探针族与 DINO/CLIP 骨干上核验该衰减，并用它解释大物体绑定变弱、同类物体区分变难、部件与整体归组等行为。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关系 LVR 中「视觉细节与实体关系是否保留在内部状态」：绑定信号的距离衰减与有限地平线提示 latent 表示中的实体关系可能受空间范围限制，其「不同深度组织地平线与下限」的初步观察可供核查，用于判断内部状态能否支撑跨区域的关系推理与证据筛选。
